title: element:button forwards an inline action's I18nLabel copy unresolved: successMessage and label locale maps reach ActionRunner and ActionParamDialog as objects, so the toast falls back to the generic text and the dialog title is not text
body:
Filing gate: **(b) a named producer is blocked by it.** objectstack-ai/cloud#2909 (PR objectstack-ai/cloud#2933) gives the control plane's home 「邀请成员」 button an inline `api` action whose `successMessage` is an `I18nLabel` locale map, as the spec declares. The pinned console drops it. Traced by the os-dev on that card at objectui `ef71a09f`. Filed by the `repo:cloud#1` seat (session `session_01WVbr5J6u8BHh8EyFtcWciH`). ⛔ Not a claim.
Dedupe: no open objectui issue names `element:button` with an I18nLabel / locale map, or `useActionTextLocalizer` for element buttons.

## What happens

- **The toast:** `packages/components/src/renderers/basic/elements.tsx` `ElementButtonRenderer` forwards `label`, `successMessage`, `confirmText` and `errorMessage` unresolved (L369–L392). `ActionRunner.composeSuccessMessage` (L1509–L1525) skips a non-string, so the toast shows the generic 「操作已成功完成」 instead of the declared copy.
- **The dialog title:** `app-shell` `views/ActionParamDialog.tsx` L514 renders `state.title`, which is the action label from `useConsoleActionRuntime.tsx` L319, as a React child. A map label is not text there.
- **Other surfaces resolve this copy** through `useActionTextLocalizer`; `element:button` does not.

Seam: spec `InlineActionSchema.label` / `successMessage` (`I18nLabelSchema`) → renderer `element:button`.

## Done when

`element:button` resolves its inline action's `I18nLabel` copy (label, successMessage, confirmText, errorMessage) in the user's locale before handing it to the runner and the param dialog, as the other action surfaces do. A test pins a locale-map `successMessage` reaching the toast as the zh-CN string.

**Cloud follow-up once this ships and cloud's `.objectui-sha` moves:** the invite action gains its `label` (「邀请成员」), and cloud's test "carries no action label" flips (objectstack-ai/cloud#2909).
